text:
[RTCT.3.2] Canonical file layout. Note the file order:

  1. `contract:` — what the compiler reads
  2. `measurement:` — what the profile binary observed
  3. `provenance:` — which `.ds` / dialect this pairs with

```yaml
# ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║ foo.dsrt — realtime contract for foo.ds                     ║
# ║                                                             ║
# ║ The compiler reads ONLY the `contract:` mapping below.      ║
# ║ Every other section is informational — runtime never sees   ║
# ║ it.                                                         ║
# ║                                                             ║
# ║ Values under `contract:` are CAPS. The runtime enforces     ║
# ║ them. Exceeding one of the counted caps REFUSES that        ║
# ║ operation with DS_ERR_CONTRACT_BREACH and leaves the engine ║
# ║ usable; exceeding pump_wcet_ns HALTS THE TIER with          ║
# ║ DS_ERR_CONTRACT_WCET_HALT and the engine does not reopen    ║
# ║ (RTCT.7.2, RTCT.7.3). The author guarantees these caps will ║
# ║ not be exceeded under any permitted input.                  ║
# ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝


# ── COMPILER READS THIS ──────────────────────────────────────────
contract:
  wm_max:             <int>      # max simultaneous facts
  agenda_cap:         <int>      # max queued activations
  max_fires_per_pump: <int>      # pump fire upper bound
  token_pool_cap:     <int>      # total tokens across all betas
  intern_cap:         <int>      # interned-string slots
  intern_bytes_cap:   <int>      # interned-string byte capacity
  cache_cap:          <int>      # max live cache keys
  cache_bytes_cap:    <int>      # cache value byte capacity
  json_depth_cap:        <int>   # optional; lowers Json depth (max 16)
  json_node_cap:         <int>   # optional; lowers Json nodes per value (max 256)
  json_string_bytes_cap: <int>   # optional; lowers Json string bytes (max 16384)
  json_text_bytes_cap:   <int>   # optional; lowers Json text per parse (max 24576)
  pump_wcet_ns:       <int>      # per-pump wall-clock ceiling

  nodes:                           # one entry per network node
    - node_id:  <int>
      kind:     alpha | beta | term
      capacity: <int>

  series:                          # one entry per series backend
    - series_id: <int>
      capacity:  <int>


# ── COMPILER IGNORES EVERYTHING BELOW ────────────────────────────

measurement:                       # profile-binary output
  ds_version:     "<string>"
  recorded_at:    "<RFC 3339 UTC>"
  rt_mode:        rt | non-rt
  pump_count:     <int>
  workload_label: "<string>"

  wm:
    peak:           <int>
    asserts_total:  <int>
    retracts_total: <int>

  agenda:
    peak: <int>

  timing:
    pump_pmin_ns:  <int>
    pump_pmean_ns: <int>
    pump_p99_ns:   <int>
    pump_pmax_ns:  <int>

  memory:
    init_bytes:    <int>
    runtime_bytes: <int>          # MUST be 0 for RT-clean

  intern:
    peak:       <int>
    bytes_peak: <int>

  fire_rate:
    per_pump_peak: <int>
    per_pump_p99:  <int>

  schemas:
    - id:        <int>
      name:      "<string>"
      fact_peak: <int>

  nodes:
    alpha:
      - id:             <int>
        matched_peak:   <int>
        hash_load_peak: <float>
    beta:
      - id:          <int>
        tokens_peak: <int>
    terminal:
      - id:                  <int>
        rule:                "<string>"
        firings_total:       <int>
        fires_per_pump_peak: <int>

  series:
    - series_id:    <int>
      backend:      "<string>"
      samples_peak: <int>


provenance:                        # which source/dialect this pairs with
  ds_basename:        "<string>"
  dialect_tier:       "<string>"
  dialect_extensions: [<sorted strings>]
```
